<thought>We need the SMILES of the unknown sample. The only way to infer it without prior knowledge is to obtain experimental data for the sample. The cheapest available tool that provides data without requiring a SMILES input is `carbon_nmr_spectra`, which returns the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample at hand. This will give us carbon chemical shift information that can be used to deduce the molecular structure with minimal cost.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
<action_input>{}</action_input>
